findings.summary: The decode loop does not enforce additional behavior because the same function later rejects every percent sign.
findings.consequence: Route validation appears to have a percent-decoding policy that is not actually needed for any accepted input, adding an avoidable branch and helper dependency at an API boundary.
findings.evidence: The owned unit calls repeatedlyDecode(value, maxAuthorIdLength) on line 134 and requires decoded === value on line 135, but line 139 rejects all values containing "%". For inputs without "%", decodeURIComponent cannot decode an escape sequence, so the decode check only duplicates the later percent ban and malformed-percent rejection covered by line 139.
findings.recommendation: Replace the decode branch with the established route-segment predicate shape, e.g. type-check unknown first and then validate the string with the same rules as validRouteSegment(value, 100), keeping only author-specific checks if any are actually different.
